summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Watchlist not persisting across logins  **What I did:** Read-only audit of the full chain — `WatchlistPage.tsx`, `client/src/lib/api.ts`, `useAuth.tsx`, `vite.config.ts`, `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts`, `modules/watchlist/schema.ts`, `modules/auth/handlers.ts`, `db/auth.ts`, `db/index.ts`, `server.ts`. No files were edited.  **What I found:** The obvious suspects are all clean, which changes the shape of this ticket. - `WatchlistPage.tsx` has no localStorage/anonymous fallback — every read/write goes through `api.get/post/delete`. - `api.ts`'s shared fetch wrapper
